verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Finix's payout docs are U.S.-centric (ACH, wire, card payouts, bank verification) with no mention of local-currency payouts, FX conversion mechanics, or settlement to local bank rails abroad; the only 'international' mention is a fee-customization option (finix-docs-25), not actual local payout rails or FX handling. Absence of evidence for this applicable, plausible payments-platform capability means it cannot be credited.
